summary: Alerts from the scan of X, which runs every 10 minutes in the morning, every 5 minutes from noon to 10:00 pm, every 10 minutes late evening and every hour overnight (2:00 am to 8:00 am Singapore time) on weekdays, and every 3 hours from Saturday 3:00 am to Monday 3:00 am Singapore time. Event time is when the incident happened, which can differ from when it was reported; it says not stated when sources don't give it. Counts and the net read cover the rolling last 24 hours; the feed lists all stored alerts.

netRead.bottom: Supply risk dominates: IRGC says three more tankers hit Hormuz mines, plus Qeshm strikes, lost refining capacity and Iran rejecting direct US talks.

brent.detail: Brent up 1.76% at $106.61 by 07:44 GMT (3:44 pm SGT, 3 Nov), per a Reuters-based market relay on X; WTI futures up $2.14 at $98.60 per First Squawk (3:15 pm SGT); Brent settled $104.77 on Monday

alerts.eventTime: Early hours of 3 Nov, Iran time (~9:00 am SGT, est.)
alerts.headline: Iran's IRGC Navy says three oil tankers that switched off tracking and used unauthorised Strait of Hormuz routes struck naval mines and are burning, abandoned on the southern shore; vessels not named, no independent confirmation
alerts.source: CGTN Europe (IRGC Navy statement)

alerts.headline: Iran's security council chief Mohsen Rezaei reportedly rejected a Qatari plan for direct contact between US diplomats and Iran's delegation in Doha; mediation by Qatar and Pakistan stays indirect, focused on reopening Hormuz
alerts.source: Open Source Intel

alerts.headline: Iranian assessments reportedly see a return to war as increasingly likely, as President Pezeshkian, Speaker Qalibaf and FM Araghchi urge the military to engage with Qatar's proposal
alerts.source: First Squawk

alerts.headline: Aramco CEO Nasser says the global refining market has lost 5 mb/d of supply and tanker attacks have eliminated 15% of effective tanker capacity; spot crude now trades above futures
alerts.source: First Squawk; LiveSquawk

alerts.headline: Aramco CEO Nasser says Saudi output can return to pre-conflict levels within days and reach 12 mb/d max capacity in under three weeks; warns of winter pressure on energy markets
alerts.source: Nader Itayim; First Squawk

alerts.headline: Senior Iranian official tells Reuters Iran and the US are far from a deal to end the war, saying Tehran will not accept excessive US demands
alerts.source: LiveSquawk, citing Reuters

alerts.headline: Trump tells Fox News the US may need to strike Iran's Pickaxe Mountain nuclear site, saying it would not be a problem and could be done within an hour
alerts.source: Open Source Intel, citing Trump on Fox News

alerts.headline: Kazakhstan says oil transit on the Atyrau-Samara pipeline has resumed after a drone attack halted flows on 2 Nov, restoring Kazakh crude flows into Russia's Transneft system
alerts.source: Kazakhstan statement, via Giovanni Staunovo (#OOTT)

alerts.headline: India confirms Indian dhow MSV Al Jusufi was struck by an unidentified aerial object off Oman's coast on 2 Nov; one of 14 Indian crew killed, 13 rescued by Oman's coast guard
alerts.source: India's Shipping Minister Sarbananda Sonowal, via ANI

alerts.headline: Ukrainian drones reportedly struck Russia's Yaroslavl oil refinery, setting off a fire in the industrial zone, as part of the large overnight drone raid on western Russia
alerts.source: Several OSINT accounts incl. Exilenova+, WW3 Monitor and Russian-language channels (translated)

alerts.headline: WSJ: CENTCOM has been laying the groundwork for wider strikes on Iran, moving more missile defenses and munitions into the region, and Washington has told Gulf states to prepare for a short, focused operation shortly after the US midterm elections
alerts.source: Wall Street Journal via Post Open Source

alerts.eventTime: 9:00 am, 3 Nov (est., raid ongoing at time of post)
alerts.headline: OSINTtechnical says a large Ukrainian drone raid is under way deep into western Russia, with local reports of hundreds of drones heading for targets, after four straight nights of hits on Russian oil sites
alerts.source: OSINTtechnical

alerts.eventTime: 4:44 am, 3 Nov (est., from first IRNA blast reports)
alerts.headline: US officials confirm to the Wall Street Journal that the US carried out limited strikes on Iran's Qeshm Island, reportedly a 'defensive' move to curb Iran's ability to strike Hormuz shipping; first US confirmation after Iranian reports of blasts
alerts.source: Open Source Intel, AMK Mapping and Post Open Source, citing the WSJ and US officials

alerts.headline: US official says Washington will host a second high-level trilateral Ukraine-Russia meeting in Abu Dhabi on Nov 10-11, covering de-escalation, post-war security and ending the war; Witkoff says US negotiators meet European allies and NATO in Brussels this week
alerts.source: Barak Ravid (Axios) and FirstSquawk, citing a senior US official and envoy Witkoff

alerts.headline: Axios: CIA Director Ratcliffe is advising Trump to keep the "no war, no deal" status quo with Iran and let the economic pressure campaign continue, arguing prolonged pain will force more Iranian concessions
alerts.source: Barak Ravid (Axios), citing sources

alerts.headline: Iran's Fars reports explosions heard off the coast of Bandar Lengeh in the Strait of Hormuz, as trackers see seven USAF aerial refueling tankers, an AWACS and a P-8 patrol plane over Hormuz and the Gulf of Oman, fuelling talk of new US strikes
alerts.source: Fars via Visioner; BashaReport and UK Report flight tracking

alerts.headline: Explosion reported at sea southwest of Iran's Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz; an OSINT account says the IRGC is attacking vessels in the strait with anti-ship cruise missiles or drones
alerts.source: AMK Mapping and FromIran via local reports

alerts.headline: Iran's IRNA reports five loud explosions on Qeshm Island near the Strait of Hormuz, with residents seeing two aircraft overhead and more blasts reported in Bandar Abbas; unconfirmed reports say US strikes hit Iranian air defenses
alerts.source: FaytuksNetwork, Visioner and War Monitor, citing IRNA and local witnesses

alerts.headline: IRGC claims it shot down a US MQ-9 Reaper drone (its 55th) over the eastern Strait of Hormuz and brought down two US MQM-170 reconnaissance drones near Qeshm Island using electronic warfare
alerts.source: IRGC claim, relayed by MenchOsint, Open Source Intel and Iran Nuances

alerts.headline: Kan News: Saudi Defense Minister Khalid bin Salman told Tehran in person that no attacks on Iran will be launched from Saudi territory or airspace, in return for Iran leaving the kingdom alone
alerts.source: Open Source Intel and Post Open Source citing Kan News

alerts.headline: President Trump tells Axios he is 'in no rush' to decide whether to resume fighting in Iran, letting talks play out; VP Vance says some progress made and no deadline set to resume strikes
alerts.source: Barak Ravid (Axios), OSINTdefender and LiveSquawk

alerts.headline: President Zelenskyy says Ukraine has intel that Russia is preparing a new massive attack primarily targeting Ukraine's energy and logistics, timed for the US midterms
alerts.source: Volodymyr Zelenskyy (official account)

alerts.headline: President Trump says an Iran deal is 'coming together nicely, that's why oil is down', adding that Iran asked the US to stop killing its leaders and 'we will'
alerts.source: Zerohedge and Giovanni Staunovo relaying Trump remarks

alerts.headline: UKMTO Warning 193-26: a ship has been struck in the Strait of Hormuz off the coast of Oman, the latest in a run of attacks on Gulf shipping; vessel and damage not yet stated
alerts.source: UKMTO Operations Centre on X, relayed by Israel War Room and Post Open Source

alerts.headline: President Trump says he is in no hurry to end the US naval blockade and economic pressure on Iran, saying 'we are paralyzing their economy' and that Iranian leaders lack urgency, tempering hopes of a quick deal
alerts.source: Trump remarks via Open Source Intel (Osint613) on X

alerts.headline: Diplomatic sources tell Lebanon's Al Jadeed a breakthrough has been reached in US-Iran negotiations after Qatari mediation overcame procedural obstacles (single-outlet report, no official confirmation)
alerts.source: Al Jadeed via LiveSquawk and Amena Bakr on X

alerts.headline: Explosion and large fire at HPCL's Visakh refinery in Visakhapatnam, India; fire tenders rushed in, cause and damage not yet known
alerts.source: Deccan Chronicle and multiple local reports on X

alerts.headline: Houthi military spokesman Yahya Saree claims drone strikes on Saudi Arabia's Dammam airport in the oil-rich Eastern Province (two drones, saying air traffic was disrupted), plus an early-warning radar and a military transport aircraft in Jizan, over the past 48 hours; separately, Saudi Arabia reportedly said it intercepted two drones over Riyadh just after midnight. Damage unverified.
alerts.source: Houthi military spokesman Yahya Saree (Arabic statement), via Open Source Intel and MenchOsint

alerts.headline: Kazakhstan says oil flows on the Atyrau-Samara pipeline have been halted, with some reports linking it to a drone attack; the line carries Kazakh crude into Russia's Transneft system via the Samara hub hit by Ukrainian drones earlier today.
alerts.source: Walter Bloomberg, FinancialJuice, CGTN Europe (Kazakhstan statement; drone cause unconfirmed)

alerts.headline: Explosions and gunfire reported at the British Embassy in Baghdad, per Iran's Tasnim news agency, a day after Iran designated the UK Royal Navy and RAF as terrorist organizations; cause and casualties unknown, no UK or Iraqi confirmation yet
alerts.source: Tasnim report, via War Radar, Walter Bloomberg (DeItaone) and UK_REPT

alerts.headline: Iran's President Pezeshkian says the Supreme Leader has granted the government authority over negotiations, a step toward talks with Washington; posts report crude falling about 5% on the news
alerts.source: Iranian President Pezeshkian, via IRNA, OSINT613 and Post Open Source

alerts.headline: Iran's navy says an oil tanker that had switched off its navigation and identification systems struck a naval mine in a restricted, unsafe area of the eastern Strait of Hormuz and caught fire; the vessel is not named and there is no independent confirmation
alerts.source: Iranian state media (IRIB), via FinancialJuice, LiveSquawk and CGTN

alerts.headline: IRGC claims 11 tankers have burned in the Strait of Hormuz since Oct 25, a much larger tally than the four it claimed earlier today; no independent confirmation
alerts.source: FirstSquawk (X)

alerts.headline: FirstSquawk: start of Iran-US negotiations depends on an end of the US naval blockade (speaker not named, apparently Iran's side), a further hardening of terms minutes after Iran said Hormuz cannot reopen before sanctions are lifted
alerts.source: FirstSquawk (X)

alerts.headline: Iran says the Strait of Hormuz cannot be reopened before US sanctions are lifted, hardening its terms just as oil fell on hopes for Qatar-led talks and a two-day reopening plan
alerts.source: First Squawk and FinancialJuice headlines

alerts.headline: UKMTO says a tanker in the Strait of Hormuz was hit by limpet mines, sparking an engine-room fire and temporarily disabling it; crew safe, no spill. Three maritime security sources name it as the Panama-flagged Louise 1
alerts.source: Adi Imsirovic, relaying UKMTO and maritime security sources

alerts.headline: IRGC Navy now claims four oil tankers caught fire and exploded in the Strait of Hormuz after using what it calls unauthorised routes, up from the two it reported earlier; no independent confirmation of the extra vessels
alerts.source: Ships & Ports, relaying an IRGC Navy claim

alerts.headline: Saudi Civil Defense sounds early warnings of possible danger in Abha, Khamis Mushait and Taif in southwest Saudi Arabia amid a reported Yemeni (Houthi) attack; small-account claims that oil facilities were targeted are unverified
alerts.source: Saudi Civil Defense via Al-Araby Al-Jadeed and Al Mayadeen

alerts.headline: Ukrainian drones hit Transneft's Samara crude pumping and dispatch station (LPDS Samara) in Prosvet, Samara Oblast, a key hub that blends crude into Urals export grade; a fire broke out. It is the third attack on the site in recent weeks, and damage is not yet known
alerts.source: Exilenova+, Charter97 (Russian), Mockingjay News UA; claim attributed to Ukraine's Unmanned Systems Forces

alerts.headline: WSJ: Washington is pushing to restore Russian gas flows to Europe via Ukraine, aiming to secure an energy truce between Moscow and Kyiv that could pause strikes on energy sites
alerts.source: WSJ report, relayed by LiveSquawk, First Squawk, RedboxGlobal and FinancialJuice

dayNote.title: Today's key developments
lines: US officials confirmed limited strikes on Iran's Qeshm Island, Iran's IRGC says three tankers hit mines and are burning in Hormuz, and Tehran reportedly rejected direct US talks in Doha.
Ukrainian drones hit Russia's Yaroslavl refinery, while Aramco said it can restore Saudi output within days but warned refining has lost 5 mb/d of supply.
